title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-11
lineage: MSR> one cassette gen> DAT> CDR> shn

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of the legendary 9/11/73 William & Mary show – Weather Report Suite shines, Dark Star → Morning Dew erupts, and China‑Rider glides superbly.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is remarkably clear with only occasional pops, letting the band’s chemistry shine through.  Highlights include a soaring Weather Report Suite with horns, an adventurous Dark Star that builds into a thunderous Phil Lesh solo before resolving into one of the most emotive Morning Dew ever, plus a buttery China‑Rider transition and a wah‑infused Playing in the Band.  Overall the performance is energetic, jazz‑tinged and tightly executed, making this one of ’73’s standout tapes.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 4–5 stars, praising both musical performance and audio fidelity; only a few low‑star outliers mention minor setlist quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with crisp highs and solid lows; occasional tiny pops/cracks noted but not disruptive. Horns on Weather Report Suite can sound a bit forward, yet overall the SBD is clean and well balanced.

standout_songs: Weather Report Suite (Prelude > Part 1 > Let It Grow)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rolls strong with tight transitions (China‑Rider, LLR, Playin’), while the second set escalates through horns‑enhanced Weather Report Suite into a soaring Dark Star that bursts into an unforgettable Morning Dew; overall pacing feels natural and exhilarating.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for expressive wah‑wah solo in Playing in the Band, passionate vocals, creative lead work throughout especially on Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: His thunderous bass solo in Dark Star is repeatedly highlighted as a show‑stealer; overall bass work described as booming and adventurous.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboards are solid but not specifically singled out; no notable criticism or praise beyond fitting the jam context.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming called “stellar” and compared to Mitch Mitchell; rhythm section praised for driving the jams.
